caption: The video captures a single white twin-engine commercial jet with a red tail logo and red wingtip accents, viewed from below against a cloudless, uniform blue sky. The aircraft occupies the center-right, drifting slowly leftward and upward while its apparent size increases somewhat. Its fuselage attitude rotates gradually, from a steep diagonal with the nose toward the upper left to a shallower, more horizontal orientation with the nose pointing left. As the rotation proceeds, the wing span tilts and more of the fuselage side becomes visible, while the underside remains apparent. The two engines slung beneath the wings remain in view throughout. The red markings on the tail and wingtips persist continuously.
relations: Aircraft drifting left and upward -> apparent size increases against the cloudless blue sky.
Fuselage attitude rotating from steep diagonal -> orientation shifts to a shallower, more horizontal angle.
Wing span tilting during rotation -> more fuselage side is revealed while underside and engines remain visible.
Continuous flight path -> red tail logo and wingtip accents persist without fading.
